success.description: You assume the appearance of another humanoid creature, at least as large as a goblin but no larger than an orc. This change in form is only an illusion, and does not confer any change to characteristics or equipment. Anyone passing an (Int) check opposed by your Spellcraft (Int) sees through the disguise. This spell lasts until the end of the encounter or until you dismiss it, at which point it recharges
